capacity_gross_kwh.notes: 109 kWh battery (InsideEVs; EVspecs.org lists it as gross).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EVspecs.org: 104 kWh usable (page notes some figures are estimated).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: SAE Media article: 370 V nominal (hub motors on 370 V nominal), 109 kWh pack; 370 V is in the 400 V class.

dc_max_kw.notes: DC fast charging up to 150 kW (EVspecs.org agrees).

ac_max_kw.notes: 11 kW maximum on-board charger (EVspecs.org; page notes some figures are estimated).
